title: Yellow Creamy Mexican Kabanos Churros
description: A creamy and romantic Mexican dish featuring Polish kabanos sausage, spherified and formed into churros, with a low-calorie twist.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the heavy cream, sodium alginate, and yellow food coloring, and heat over low heat, whisking constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Remove the cream mixture from the heat and let it cool to room temperature.
In a large bowl, whisk together the water and sliced kabanos sausage.
Add the cooled cream mixture to the bowl and whisk until well combined.
Using a syringe or piping bag, drop the mixture into the vegetable oil, heated to 375 degrees Fahrenheit, to form the churros.
Fry the churros for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the churros from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
In a small bowl, whisk together the cinnamon sugar and egg.
Toss the fried churros in the cinnamon sugar mixture to coat.
Serve the churros warm and enjoy.
